theme_concept.name: Academic Enterprise Void
theme_concept.description: A clean, modern, dark-mode-first aesthetic inspired by Notion and Perplexity, but elevated with 'Swiss Brutalist' and 'Terminal' micro-motifs. It prioritizes data privacy and high-density information through stark contrast, muted semantic tokens, and an overarching true-gray palette. The UI feels authoritative, scholarly, and offline-secure.
global_rules: Dark mode is the default and primary focus.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF); always tint with the background base.
Color is function only. The UI should be 90% monochrome, with colors used strictly for semantic routing (e.g., text vs visual vs fused paths).

rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Use IBM Plex Mono for all latency breakdowns, chunk sizes, filenames, and system logs.
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Accents are desaturated to prevent OLED 'glowing' fatigue.
Focus states MUST have higher contrast than the default state. Example: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-300.

app_sidebar.style: Solid Background with a hard right border.

cards_and_citations.style: Flat Solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism to preserve data clarity.
cards_and_citations.classes: bg-[#16161A] border border-[#27272A] rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:border-[#3F3F46] transition-colors

explainability_dashboard.style: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton.

drag_drop_zone.classes: relative border-2 border-dashed border-[#3F3F46] bg-[#16161A] hover:border-[#818CF8] transition-colors

layouts.page_structure: Sidebar on the left (w-64 or w-72), main content on the right. Mobile: Bottom nav or hamburger.
layouts.chat_area: Max-width centered container (max-w-4xl) within the main area, ensuring spacious reading. Input anchored at the bottom.

dashboard_grid.name: High Density Grid
dashboard_grid.strategy: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6.

layouts.spacing: Use Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 for card internals to prevent text collision.

chat_search.instructions: Input area should be large, multi-line, placed at bottom. Answers must stream in. Source citations should appear as a horizontal flex list of small cards above the answer. Each citation card includes an icon (doc/image/audio), filename (mono font), and relevance score.

knowledge_base.instructions: Use Shadcn Table. Dense styling. Columns: Modality (Icon), Name, Size, Chunk Count, Status (Badge), Actions (Delete/Re-index). Include a top bar for 'Bulk Actions' and collection filtering.

explainability_dashboard.instructions: Divide into 3 logical columns for Text, Visual, and Fused rankings. Use Recharts for the latency breakdown (Stacked Bar) and Recharts ScatterChart for the 2D embedding space (UMAP/t-SNE). Data must use the designated semantic colors (Indigo, Amber, Rose).

ingestion_pipeline.instructions: Massive drag-and-drop zone. Below it, a live list of files currently processing. Status uses a step-based horizontal progress indicator: Queued -> Parsing -> Embedding -> Indexed. Use IBM Plex Mono for the log outputs.

system_status_panel.instructions: Place in sidebar or top header. Needs a glowing dot (green/red) indicating 'Offline Mode Active'. Display current loaded model and ChromaDB collection stats (doc counts).

settings.instructions: Use Shadcn Sliders for chunk size, overlap, top-k, and RRF weighting. Clean form layouts with clear description text below each label.

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements (transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease).
Staggered entrance animations for chat messages and dashboard widgets (framer-motion).
Micro-animations on citations (slight translateY on hover).

3d_and_charts.instructions: Use Recharts for the 2D embedding space scatter plot and latency breakdowns. Ensure charts have transparent backgrounds to blend with the UI. Use a dark-mode optimized axis color (#52525B) and tooltip styling.

empty_states_and_login.description: Abstract blue glowing dots forming wave patterns

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Render images conditionally with dark overlays (bg-black/60) if used as backgrounds.

rules: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, describing their role.
Use sonner for accessible toast notifications.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add recharts framer-motion lucide-react sonner
Use standard Shadcn UI components but strip away default shadows and excessive border radii. Set global radius to 0.3rem or 0.5rem max.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Always use solid #16161A with borders.
Apply `data-testid` to EVERY button, link, input, and interactive chart element.
Follow the High Density Grid pattern for the Explainability Dashboard, ensuring all charts fill their containers completely.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
